title: Electric Boogaloo
description: Adds  a new zombie dancing boss, Electric Boogaloo with his iconic Backup Dancers from the Plants Versus Zombies Games
body: # ⚡ Electric Boogaloo Bring the disco fever of **Plants vs. Zombies** into Minecraft with the **Electric Boogaloo Mod**! This mod adds the legendary Dancing Zombie himself, **Electric Boogaloo**, along with his backup dancers, straight from PvZ. This was made for the upcoming Integrated Boogaloo modpack but feel free to use it in your own! This is a very, very goofy mod meant for silly people. This mod will have custom music and drops from the new boss added in the future. *** He spawns at night with a configurable spawn chance. All of his attributes are configurable, like health, damage, etc. He has a few moves like summoning backup dancers, striking with lightning, and powering up the backup dancers. *** [![](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/452/988/bh_id_promo.png)](https://www.bisecthosting.com/craisincraft)   I’ve spent thousands of hours on my mods.
